help: Copy to benchmark/fixtures/labels.json (git-ignored) and edit. Keys are user message item ids from user-messages.jsonl. 'labels' replaces the heuristic labels; 'add'/'remove' amend them; 'topic' groups corrections about the same complaint (repeat-correction rate uses topics when present). Allowed labels: correction, preference, approval, decision, pending_request, progress_query, message_complaint, question.

u4.note: a durable preference, not a complaint about wording
